title: Search tickets
what: Search by ID, title, people (assignee/QC), state; accents optional.

how.t: Type keywords in the "Find a ticket" box

how: Press / to jump to the search box from anywhere; press Esc in the box to clear it
keys: search tickets find shortcut slash /

title: AI filter (a sentence becomes a filter)
what: Type a sentence (e.g. "my critical bugs this sprint") and the AI turns it into a State / Priority / Type / People / Sprint / keyword filter.

how.t: Type a sentence in the "Find a ticket" box

how: The "AI set the filter" notice appears; see the filter chips below. Also works from ⌘K
keys: ai filter filter with ai natural language sentence

title: Filter by Priority / Type / State (with counts)
what: Three rows of chips with counts for the current filter; pick several values per row. Rare values sit behind "+N more".

how.t: In the "Filters" group, click the "Priority", "Type" or "State" box
Tick the values you want (e.g. "Critical", "Bug"); the number on the right is the ticket count

how: Click "Clear all" in that box to drop the filter; the chips under the toolbar remove them one by one too
keys: filter priority filter type filter state chips counts bug feature task

title: Ready-made views per role
what: One click sets the filters + Table/Board + grouping. Dev: My board, This sprint, Awaiting QC, My bugs, Overdue. QA/QC: Test board, No QC yet, Open bugs, New bugs in 7 days, Regression. PO/PM: Backlog, Waiting for PO sign-off, Sprint by person, Sprint board, Unassigned.

how.t: Click "Views" on the right of the toolbar
Click a view suggested for your role (e.g. "My board", "Waiting for QC")

how: The "View …" notice confirms; the filters, Table/Board and grouping have changed
keys: views preset my board this sprint backlog regression waiting for po decision sprint by person test board

title: Quick filters
what: Ready-made filters: Blocked; Critical / Highest; Overdue; Unassigned; In sprint, not estimated; Backlog not in a sprint; Waiting for PO sign-off; Waiting for test, no QC yet; Open bugs; Critical / Highest bugs; New bugs in 7 days; Built, waiting for release; Forgotten (>7 days without update).

how.t: Click a row in the "Needs attention" card to see the ticket list
Click a view that uses a quick filter (e.g. "Overdue", "Open bugs", "Backlog")
Click the "Filter …" chip above to remove the quick filter

keys: quick filter blocked overdue unassigned not estimated backlog waiting for po decision open bugs forgotten stale

title: Saved views
what: Saves the current filters + view type (Table/Board) under a name to reopen quickly; also shown in ⌘K.

how.t: Set the filters you want, then click "Views"
Type a name in the "View name" box

how: Open "Views" again: your saved view is under "Saved", click ✕ next to its name to delete it
keys: saved views save filters bookmark view

title: Switch Table / Board
what: See tickets as a table or as a board with State columns.

how.t: Click "Table" to go back to the table

keys: table board kanban view type

title: Drag cards to change State
what: On the Board, drag a card to another column to change its State on YouTrack; the notice has an undo button. Drag a column header to reorder the columns (remembered per project). Done columns are folded into one button.
how: Drag a ticket card to another State column; the "VA-1 → State" notice has an undo button

how.t: Click the vertical "Done" column to show the done columns (click again to hide them)
how.at: css:button[aria-label="Hiện các cột đã xong"], button[aria-label="Ẩn các cột đã xong"]

how: Drag a column header (the State name) left / right to reorder the columns; the order is remembered for that project
Each column shows at most 60 cards; filter to see the rest
keys: drag drop change state reorder columns order board columns done undo

title: Group the ticket table
what: Groups the table by Assignee, Sprint (default) or Module / App (the first tag in the title); each group can be collapsed/expanded.

how.t: Click "Table" (grouping is only in table view)
Click "Display" on the right of the toolbar
Choose a type in the "Group by" box
Click a group header to collapse / expand it

keys: group by assignee sprint module app collapse group

title: Sort by column
what: Sorts the table by ID, Type, Title, State, Priority, Assignee, QC, Sprint, Due, Updated.

how.t: Click a column name in the table header to sort ascending ▲
Click that column again to reverse ▼

keys: sort columns ascending descending

title: Display: compact mode, resolved tickets, High+ highlight
what: Display options: "Compact: short rows, one-line titles" (dense mode); "Show resolved tickets"; "Highlight High and above" (Critical/Highest/High get a colored background). Saved for next time.

how.at: Gọn: hàng thấp, tiêu đề 1 dòng
Tô nền ticket High trở lên

keys: compact mode dense mode short rows resolved done highlight high critical

title: Show/hide table columns
what: Choose which columns to show (Type, State, Priority, Assignee, QC, Sprint, Due, Updated); each role has its own default columns.

how.t: Under "Columns", tick/untick a column (e.g. the first one)

keys: columns hide columns show columns due updated qc sprint

title: Export the ticket list as CSV
what: Downloads the whole filtered list (not just what is shown) with the visible columns as a CSV file.

how.t: Click the download button "Export CSV" at the end of the toolbar

keys: export csv excel download

title: Select several tickets, bulk-change Assignee / State / Priority, ask the AI
what: Tick several tickets to change their Assignee, State (following the workflow) or Priority at once: picking a value applies it right away, with undo; tickets that fail stay selected so you can retry. Or open an AI session about the selected tickets.

how.t: Tick the box at the start of a row
Click "Assignee" on the "… tickets selected" bar (or "State" / "Priority")
how.at: css:[role="region"][aria-label="Thao tác hàng loạt"] button[aria-label^="Đổi assignee"]

how.t: Type a name in the "Search people…" box
Pick a person: it applies to every selected ticket right away

how: If it was a mistake, click Undo in the notice
keys: select several bulk change assignee change state priority deselect select all

title: Change the assignee right in the table
what: Change the assignee directly in the Assignee column; the notice has an undo button.

how.t: Click the Assignee box of the row and pick a person (or "Unassigned")

how: Click undo in the notice if it was a mistake
keys: change assignee assign who works on it

title: Copy ID / Copy link, open on YouTrack
what: Hover a row to show the Copy ID and Copy link buttons; click the ID to open the ticket on YouTrack in a new tab.

how.t: Hover a row and click "Copy ID"
Click the ID itself to open it on YouTrack in a new tab

keys: copy id copy link open youtrack ticket link

title: The "new" label (updated since your last visit)
what: Tickets updated since you last viewed this project get a "new" label next to the ID (shown only when there are such tickets).
how: Look for the "new" label next to the ID of tickets updated since your last visit; hover for the explanation
keys: new recently updated unseen unread

title: Preview the description on hover
what: Hover a row for about half a second to show a preview card: title, State, Priority, Assignee and part of the description (not on touch screens).

how.t: Hover a ticket row for about half a second (don't click) to show the preview card

keys: quick look preview hover description tooltip

title: Ticket page keyboard shortcuts
what: Drive the table from the keyboard: / search, j/k move between rows, Space selects a row, Enter opens the ticket, Esc clears the search, then the selection. Press ? to see every YouTrack shortcut; g then h / t / d / r / p / a goes to Home / Ticket / Dashboard / Release / Members / AI history.
how: Press / to go to the search box; j (down) / k (up) to move between rows
Press x to tick/untick the current row; Enter to open the ticket
Press Esc: in the search box it clears the keywords, otherwise it clears the selected rows
keys: keyboard shortcuts j k x enter esc slash keyboard navigation

title: YouTrack shortcuts (? and g + key)
what: Press ? on any YouTrack page to open the shortcut sheet. g then h / t / d / r / p / a goes to Home / Ticket / Dashboard / Release / Members / AI history; ⌘/Ctrl+K opens quick commands. Space selects a row as in Telegram.
how: Press ? to see the shortcut sheet
Press g then the letter of the page you want
keys: shortcuts youtrack g keys switch page space select

title: More tickets as you scroll
what: The table shows the first 150 rows; scrolling near its end shows 150 more by itself.
how: Scroll to the bottom of the table: the next rows appear by themselves
keys: show more load more pagination scroll infinite

title: Global search by ID
what: When no ticket matches, find any ticket on YouTrack by number or ID, even outside the loaded data.

how.t: Type a keyword with no results into the "Find a ticket" box
Type a number or ID (e.g. VA-123) into the "Global search by ID" box
Click "Clear filters" to drop every filter

keys: global search search by id not found clear filters
